source.section: Form NJ-1040 lines 16a, 20a, 27, 28a, 28b, 29: Instr PDF p.15 line 20a, PDF p.21 line 27, PDF p.22 line 28a (Line A, Line B and chart), PDF p.22 line 28b and PDF p.23 Worksheet D lines 1-9 with the Maximum Exclusion chart, PDF p.22 line 29; PDF p.8 lines 6-7 (regular and senior 65+ exemptions), PDF p.9 line 13, PDF p.25 line 30, PDF p.27 lines 38-39, PDF p.33 lines 42-43, PDF p.65 Tax Rate Schedules

worked: Federal AGI 90,000.00 (private pension 85,000.00 + interest 5,000.00); federal taxable income = 90,000.00 - 17,750.00 federal standard deduction (15,750 single + 2,000 for age 65 or older) = 72,250.00 (given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored). Line 16a interest 5,000.00 + line 20a pension 85,000.00 = line 27 total income 90,000.00; measure 90,000.00, in the 0-100,000 band (keep share 1). Line 28a: age 66; Line A = 85,000.00, Line B = 75,000.00 single maximum; lesser = 75,000.00 (the pension is over the cap). Line 28b (Worksheet D): line 1 maximum 75,000.00 - line 2 75,000.00 = line 3 0.00, so no unclaimed exclusion; projection: unclaimed maximum 75,000 reduced by the 85,000 pension, floored at 0 = 0.00, so the 5,000 interest stays taxed. Line 29 New Jersey gross income = 90,000.00 - 75,000.00 - 0.00 = 15,000.00. Line 30 exemptions (line 13): regular 1,000 x 1 + senior 65+ 1,000 x 1 = 2,000.00; line 38 = 2,000.00 (no other deductions). Line 39/42 taxable income = 15,000.00 - 2,000.00 = 13,000.00. Line 43 tax, rate schedule Table A (single/separate) as bands: 13,000.00 x 0.014 = 182.00 = 182.00. The booklet's Tax Table (taxable income under 100,000) gives 182 for the 13,000-13,050 row (schedule at the midpoint 13,025, rounded); expected keeps the exact schedule result. No credits. State income tax = 182.00. The pension is noncontributory, so the New Jersey taxable amount (line 20a) equals the federal taxable amount and line 20b is empty.
accepted_approximations: Tax Table: for taxable income under 100,000 New Jersey uses its Tax Table, the schedule's tax at each 50-dollar row's midpoint rounded to the dollar; the projection uses the exact schedule.
